Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Manager, Network Medical Economics to join our Actuarial team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Senior Manager, Network Medical Economics leads financial analysis and provides actuarial insight to support Oscar's provider contracting and network strategy. You will own end-to-end financial evaluation of complex, high-impact provider negotiations and develops contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks to advance network affordability and performance.

In close partnership with Network Strategy & Performance, Regional Actuarial, Medical Economics, and Data teams, the Senior Manager evaluates new network strategies, identifies financial risks and opportunities, and strengthens analytical methods and tools. You will translate complex analyses into clear recommendations and reporting, helping business and operational leaders make informed decisions about provider reimbursement and network initiatives.

You will report into the Director, Actuarial.

Work Location: This position is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S., excluding Alaska; Delaware; Hawaii; Louisiana; Montana; North Dakota; Oklahoma; West Virginia; Wyoming; and U.S. Territories. Daily work is completed from your home office, with occasional travel required for team meetings and company events.

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role in the states of California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, and Washington is: $163,944 - $215,176 per year. The base pay for this role in all other locations is: $147,549 - $193,658 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end financial analysis for complex, high-impact provider negotiations, evaluating proposed reimbursement rates, contract terms, and alternative structures to inform negotiation strategy and decision-making.
  • In collaboration with Network Strategy & Performance, provide recommendations and thought partnership based on financial analysis and actuarial principles related to new network strategies and initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks aligned with business objectives.

The Data Modeler will support the design, development, and maintenance of logical and physical data models that enable analytics, reporting, and operational data use cases. The Data Modeler contributes to data quality, consistency, and usability across systems while developing expertise in enterprise data modeling, data warehousing, data integration, and database technologies.

data.title: Staff Data Product Manager (Machine Learning) - Canada
data.description:
NerdWallet’s mission is to provide clarity for all of life’s financial decisions. Machine learning is how we get there at scale. It helps us understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that fit their needs.

We’re hiring a Staff Data Product Manager to own the ML product roadmap across NerdWallet. You’ll work with our business verticals, Data Scientists, and Engineering teams to find the highest-impact opportunities and take predictive models from idea to production to adoption. The work ranges from customer lifetime value prediction to lead scoring to personalized product recommendations.

This is a product leadership role for someone who is technically fluent in ML. You won’t build models or write production code, but you’ll be a credible, peer-level partner to the people who do. You’ll challenge assumptions on ground truth, evaluation, and serving architecture, and you’ll tie every model to a business outcome.

This role reports to the VP, Data & Analytics.

Where you can make an impact:

Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering

  • Dig into modeling trade-offs, ground-truth definitions, training data quality, precision/recall, and feature strategy alongside Data Scientists and ML Engineers.

  • Navigate ML infrastructure decisions, including model serving, feature pipelines, batch vs. real-time inference, latency, and production dependencies.

  • Turn ambiguous business problems into clear model objectives, technical requirements, and measurable success criteria.

Own the roadmap and drive models into production

  • Own and prioritize the ML roadmap across verticals, balancing business impact, technical feasibility, and engineering capacity. You’ll decide what to build, defer, or say no to.

  • Work across Data Science, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, and business teams to get model predictions into consumer experiences, real-time decisioning systems, and business workflows.

  • Make sure every launch is production-ready, with clear ownership of dependencies and validated performance against technical and business requirements.

Measure what matters

  • Work with Data Science and Analytics on experiments, A/B tests, and causal measurement that prove the incremental impact of ML.

  • Define and monitor success criteria covering predictive performance, reliability, adoption, and business outcomes.

  • Explain model performance, trade-offs, limitations, and revenue impact clearly to senior stakeholders.

Lead beyond your own roadmap

  • Set the long-term vision for ML products, influence without formal authority, and mentor other product managers and partners.

Your experience:

7+ years in Data Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, with a track record of shipping production ML or data products

  • Deep fluency in applied ML: training data, ground truth, loss functions, precision/recall, overfitting, and model evaluation

  • Strong understanding of ML platforms and infrastructure: model serving, feature pipelines, batch vs. real-time inference, latency trade-offs, and deployment workflows

  • Experience partnering directly with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to challenge assumptions and navigate complex dependencies

  • Experience with modern data and ML tools such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar

  • Strong business sense, with the ability to connect ML work to revenue growth, customer lifetime value, conversion, and marketing efficiency

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership, including influencing technical and business stakeholders without formal authority

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Where:

  • This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec).

  • NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Monthly Healthcare Stipend

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Vacation Time Off + You will receive the official public holidays in your province

  • Paid sabbatical for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge and pursue their interests

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend, Wifi Stipend, and Cell Phone Stipend

  • Work from home equipment stipend

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

  • Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

  • Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

  • Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

  • RRSP with a 4% match. Eligible one month after hire.

  • Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

data.title: Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) - Canada

experience_requirements.text: 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact

data.description:
At NerdWallet, our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs.

We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) to join us as a foundational member of our new team. You’ll help shape and advance our machine learning capabilities across consumer personalization, predictive modeling, and performance marketing, with a real voice in how we work from day one. Together, we’re building an inclusive, supportive team culture where we lift each other up and succeed together to drive business impact across the organization.

In this role, you will lead the development of production-grade machine learning solutions that power some of NerdWallet's most critical business decisions. From predicting customer lifetime value and scoring incoming leads in real time to developing recommendation engines that connect consumers with the right financial products, your work will have a direct impact on how we acquire, engage, and monetize our customer relationships.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with deep expertise in applied machine learning, production ML systems, and the Databricks ecosystem. As a foundational member of the team, you’ll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to translate complex business problems into scalable ML solutions, while helping establish the technical standards and best practices for machine learning across NerdWallet.

Where you can make an impact:

Build Predictive Models That Drive Business Growth

  • Lead the end-to-end development of advanced machine learning models focused on customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion propensity, lead quality, and revenue optimization.

  • Translate model predictions into actionable signals that improve marketing investment decisions, customer acquisition efficiency, and long-term profitability.

Advance Personalization & Recommendation Systems

  • Develop recommendation and ranking models that identify the most relevant financial products for individual consumers based on their needs, behaviors, and predicted propensity to engage or convert.

  • Explore and implement approaches such as propensity modeling, learning-to-rank, and next-best-product recommendations to improve customer engagement and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to integrate predictive intelligence into consumer experiences and personalized communications.

Establish Best-in-Class ML Practices

  • Leverage Databricks and MLflow to develop, train, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models at scale.

  • Establish robust DS practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, feature engineering, automated training pipelines, model monitoring, and reproducibility.

  • Define standards for model performance, reliability, retraining, and production readiness, including monitoring for data drift and model degradation.

  • Design and evaluate experiments to measure the incremental business impact of deployed models and continuously improve their effectiveness.

  • Serve as a technical leader within Data Science, mentoring other practitioners, influencing architectural decisions, and elevating engineering and modeling standards across the organization.

Your experience:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks, including building and managing production machine learning workflows using MLflow and the Databricks ML ecosystem. Please note: this role requires hands-on Databricks experience specifically, and experience with similar platforms is not a substitute.

  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with extensive experience using modern machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

  • Strong understanding of supervised learning, predictive modeling, classification, regression, ranking, and model evaluation techniques.

  • Practical experience designing scalable batch and/or real-time inference systems, with an understanding of latency, reliability, and performance trade-offs.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, modular code design, and CI/CD practices for machine learning.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives from problem definition through deployment and business impact measurement.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion improvement, customer lifetime value, and marketing efficiency.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction and working effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Where:

  • This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec).

  • NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Monthly Healthcare Stipend

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Vacation Time Off + You will receive the official public holidays in your province

data.title: Senior Data Scientist (AI Evaluation & Improvement)
data.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the diagnostic loop for LLM-based clinical services: take failure modes surfaced by clinical reviewers and product managers, form root-cause hypotheses (prompt design, context assembly, retrieval, guideline encoding, model behavior, upstream data), and design experiments that isolate the cause.
  • Test candidate fixes — prompt and configuration variants, context changes, model alternatives — and verify improvements with structured evaluations, not anecdotes; confirm fixes don't regress other behavior.
  • Own the evaluation roadmap and quality bar for the team's AI services: which metrics gate deployment, how golden sets and regression suites grow, and what "good enough to ship" means in evidence.
  • Use and extend the team's evaluation platform: build golden sets and regression suites, define metrics (accuracy, guideline adherence, grounding/faithfulness), run and interpret eval batteries. Fluency in *using* modern eval tooling matters; the platform exists — extending it thoughtfully is in scope, rebuilding it is not.
  • Partner with clinical reviewers (medical directors) to turn review findings into labeled evidence and executable evaluation criteria; partner with product managers to prioritize which failure modes matter most.
  • Mentor others in evaluation methods and grow the evals function as it scales, including readiness to take direct reports as the team expands.
  • Support the annual clinical-guidelines update cycle with regression evaluation as guidelines, prompts, and models change; ramp with the team's senior data scientists in Q4 2026.
  • Document the diagnostic playbook: failure taxonomies, experiment templates, variant history — a method others can run, not a private intuition. This is a practicing role — the diagnostic loop is the job, at every level of seniority.
  • Handle clinical data (including PHI) according to organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of data science or applied machine learning experience, including shipping and maintaining models or AI systems in production.
  • 2+ years of recent, hands-on experience evaluating and improving LLM-based systems: structured error analysis, prompt/configuration iteration, experiment design, metrics interpretation — as a practitioner, not only as a reviewer of others' work.
  • Demonstrated experience with LLM evaluation methods and tools — golden/regression sets, LLM-as-judge with validation, tracing and observability tooling.
  • Strong Python and solid data-analysis skills (SQL a plus); comfort computing and reasoning about metrics such as sensitivity, specificity, and PPV.
  • Hypothesis-driven working style: the instinct to isolate variables and prove a fix, rather than tweak and hope.
  • Strong written communication — findings and go/no-go evidence must be legible to engineers, clinicians, and leadership.

Preferred Requirements

  • Healthcare experience: utilization management, prior authorization, clinical documentation, or clinical/claims data; comfort reading clinical guideline and medical-policy content.
  • Experience mentoring data scientists or leading small technical workstreams; interest in growing into people leadership as a function scales.
  • Experience working with clinical reviewers or other domain experts to convert expert judgment into labeled data and evaluation criteria.
  • Experience with LLM observability/telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry-based tracing, Logfire, Langfuse, or similar).
  • Statistics or experimentation background (A/B testing, statistical significance, sample-size reasoning).
  • Master's degree in a quantitative field.

Headquarters: US - Remote

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the team’s engineering practices and contribute to Airbnb’s broader data community.

A Typical Day

  • Design, build, and operate high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical financial metrics.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured, and implement consistent data models that support those definitions.
  • Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency.
  • Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.
  • Translate complex requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and practical technical designs.
  • Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.
  • Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.
  • Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.
  • Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.
  • Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks.
  • Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path.

Your Expertise

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A track record of independently delivering complex data engineering projects, from requirements and technical design through implementation and sustained production ownership.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and programming skills in Python or Scala, with experience building maintainable, well-tested data systems.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark and large-scale analytical storage systems.
  • Strong data modeling skills, including fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, incremental processing, and historical data management.
  • Experience integrating heterogeneous sources, including APIs, enterprise applications, event data, and transactional systems, while managing schema changes and source reliability.
  • Proven ability to build reliable pipelines and execute migrations and backfills while preserving correctness and downstream compatibility.
  • Experience implementing data quality controls, observability, lineage, and governance practices, and troubleshooting production data issues.
  • The ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and optimize distributed computation, storage, and query execution.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements with business partners, explain technical tradeoffs, and coordinate delivery across teams.
  • Experience contributing to design and code reviews, sharing knowledge, and supporting the development of other engineers.
  • Curiosity and sound judgment when learning new domains and balancing delivery needs with long-term system health.

Experience with AI usage or cost measurement, cloud cost attribution, Unit Economics, enterprise application data, or financial and payments datasets is a plus. Familiarity with workflow orchestration, SQL transformation frameworks, and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg is also valuable.

  •  Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team.
  • Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over.
  • Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins.
  • Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools.
  • Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support.
  • Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check.
  • Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections.
  • Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards.
  • Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira.

Your Professional Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production.
  • SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets.
  • Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams.
  • Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt.
  • Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems.
  • Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation.
  • Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision.
  • Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred.
  • Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred.
  • Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred.
  • Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred.
  • Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus.
  • Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred.

data.description:
About Valdera:

At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide.

We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.

Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.

Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.

Role Description:

We are hiring a Chemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform.

Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database.

You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources

  • Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale

  • Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics

  • Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers

  • Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings

  • Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources.

  • Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage

Experience & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets.

  • Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications

  • Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines

  • Experience with data cleaning and normalization at scale, and a good eye for spotting inconsistencies in unstructured data

  • Familiarity with building or applying matching, deduplication, or classification models (traditional ML or LLM-based approaches)

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to accelerate data extraction, enrichment, or engineering workflows

  • Startup mindset with a strong sense of ownership — comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, remote environment with ambiguous, evolving priorities

Compensation

The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior dbt Developer to lead the transformation of our clients' raw enterprise data into clean, high-performance, business-ready data models. In this role, you will own our clients' dbt architecture, standardizing how data is modeled, tested, documented, and deployed across their entire cloud data warehouse.

This role requires an engineer who treats analytics code like software: using version control, writing automated tests, optimizing warehouse compute costs, and implementing continuous integration (CI) pipelines. You will transform complex pipelines into dry, modular data environments that enable fast, accurate business decision-making.

What we are looking for:

  • 3+ years of deep, hands-on production experience architecting complex dbt Core or dbt Cloud projects.
  • Master-level proficiency in writing highly complex, optimized, and readable SQL. Deep understanding of dimensional modeling (Kimball methodology), Data Vault 2.0, or wide-table strategies for analytics.
  • Proven track record in configuring and managing large datasets within modern platforms like Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Databricks.
  • Strong version control experience using Git and setting up automated CI/CD workflows (e.g., Slim CI via GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) to test data changes before production deployment.
  • Experience extending dbt functionality using Jinja templating, writing custom macros, and implementing standard packages (such as dbt_utils, dbt_expectations, or codegen).
  • Proficiency in Python for writing advanced dbt extensions, orchestrating custom scripts, or building data extraction workflows.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Official dbt Certified Developer credential.
  • Experience with data orchestrators like Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Experience managing dbt Semantic Layer or building metrics definitions for self-service BI environments (like Looker, Tableau, or Lightdash).

Responsibilities:

  • Architect, optimize, and maintain scalable dbt models (Sources, Staging, Marts) that cleanly map raw source data to final analytical layers.

Aptive Resources is seeking a Data Analyst to support artificial intelligence (AI), analytics, and data modernization initiatives within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Research and Development (ORD). This role supports the Research IT and Data Governance (ITDG) group’s enterprise AI activities focused on research portfolio analysis, operational reporting, AI-enabled analytics, and development of scalable data capabilities supporting research, policy, and operational decision-making.

The Data Analyst will support data analysis, reporting, statistical programming, and analytics activities associated with strategic AI initiatives, research operations, and enterprise modernization efforts. The position will work closely with technical teams, project managers, operational leadership, and stakeholders to support data integration, reporting automation, AI pilot initiatives, and analytics-driven operational improvements.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analyst with experience working directly with healthcare or research data, applying statistical modeling and evaluation methods, and producing descriptive reporting that supports research and operational decision-making.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), 100% remote position. It is currently funded through September 29, 2027 under the current contract period of performance, with potential for extension into the next option year based on contract continuation and program needs.

This position may be filled at the Data Analyst – Junior or Data Analyst – Senior level. Level and salary will be determined commensurate with the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

experience_requirements.text: 5-10 years of relevant experience

data.description:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

About the Role

We're hiring a technically strong Senior Data Analyst to help modernize how our FP&A organization uses data, analytics, and automation. This is an embedded Finance role: you'll report directly to the FP&A Director and work side by side with her day to day while partnering closely with our central Data Analytics and Data Engineering teams on infrastructure, standards, and complex technical problems. It's a hands-on execution role for someone who builds.

Financial and operational data at Welocalize lives across multiple systems - Workday Financials, Adaptive Planning, Salesforce, a Redshift data warehouse, Power BI, and years of Excel workbooks carrying critical processes. Much of it doesn't connect cleanly, and a lot of institutional knowledge lives in undocumented spreadsheets, manual processes, and Power Queries rather than any system of record.

You might start with a complex, years-old Excel workbook and a simple prompt: “This is how we do this today.” Your job isn't to automate the workbook as-is - it's to understand its purpose, trace its logic to source, figure out what users actually need, and design something better: a rebuilt pipeline, a SQL/Python replacement, a driver-based view, an exception-monitoring workflow, or an AI-assisted tool.

We're just starting to build out an FP&A AI repository - documentation, business logic, and workflows meant to let AI reliably execute FP&A processes, not just answer one-off questions - and you'll partner with us to determine its direction.

This role is a deliberate combination of three things:

1. Fluency with data itself - the ability to query, shape, and manipulate data directly.

2. An engineering mindset - building automated, repeatable systems (workflows and dashboards that run and refresh on their own, integrations across tools) rather than one-off analysis, and knowing how to scope and coordinate real pipeline or data mart work with Data Engineering.

3. An investigative instinct - the ability to look at data and figure out what it's telling us, not just execute a report exactly as specified.

What You'll Do

Partner directly with FP&A leadership to understand existing reporting, analytical, and planning processes and identify where they should fundamentally change, not just get faster.

• Reverse-engineer complex Excel workbooks and manual processes to understand their data sources, business logic, calculations, and the questions their users are actually trying to answer.

• Design and build automated solutions using SQL, Python, ETL/data transformation, APIs, and modern AI tools.

• Work through large, imperfect, multi-system datasets - resolving data quality, mapping, reconciliation, and grain issues along the way.

• Perform exploratory analysis to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and underlying business drivers, rather than simply reporting what happened.

• Design dashboards and reporting experiences around the decisions people actually need to make, not a recreation of an existing spreadsheet in a new tool.

• Build AI-assisted, interactive HTML reporting tools - developed with the help of AI coding tools and engineered to refresh efficiently on their own, without repeated AI calls.

• Develop driver-based analysis, exception reporting, and monitoring approaches that surface important changes proactively.

• Explore and build AI-assisted and agentic workflows - including ways for LLMs to interact with data, tools, APIs, and reporting processes.

• Partner with the central Data Analytics and Data Engineering teams on shared data infrastructure and standards - including scoping and coordinating data pipeline and data mart requests.

• Contribute in a leadership capacity within the analytics function even without formal management responsibility - shaping how problems get approached, mentoring by example, and helping set the bar for analytical rigor.

• Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for Finance leaders and other business stakeholders.

• Partner in building out our FP&A AI repository - the documentation, conventions, and workflows meant to let an AI assistant execute FP&A processes reliably - and help shape its direction as we go.

How You Think

Technical skills matter, but how you approach problems matters just as much. We're looking for someone who:

• Is genuinely curious and naturally asks “why?” when something doesn't reconcile or doesn't make sense.

• Enjoys digging into messy or unfamiliar data and figuring out how things connect.

• Doesn't assume an existing process or report is right simply because that's how it's always been done.

• Can take an ambiguous problem and independently structure an approach to solving it, while knowing when to pull others in rather than spinning wheels alone.

• Looks beyond the initial request to identify opportunities, risks, and better approaches the requester may not have thought to ask for.

• Enjoys collaborative problem-solving - bouncing ideas around, testing hypotheses, and challenging assumptions to get to a stronger answer.

• Takes ownership of the areas they work in - the business purpose, the data, the known issues, and the opportunities for improvement - rather than treating each request as a one-off ticket.

• Likes building things, experimenting, and continuously improving how work gets done.

Required Skills and Experience

5-10 years of relevant experience required. You should be genuinely, hands-on strong across:

• SQL - comfortable joining tables, tracing grain, finding duplicates, and validating results in unfamiliar schemas.

• Python - practical proficiency for data transformation, analysis, and automation.

• ETL/ELT fluency - strong enough understanding of pipeline design to define data requirements, validate output, and partner effectively with Data Engineering on pipeline and data mart requests. Hands-on pipeline-building experience is a plus.

• Report and dashboard building - able to design and build a reporting/analytical experience end-to-end, whether on a modern BI platform (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar) or as a standalone interactive HTML/web-based report. Standalone HTML/web-based reports are increasingly our primary format.

• Automation - demonstrated experience automating manual, recurring data or reporting workflows.

• Comfort learning and adopting new AI-assisted tools and workflows - you should be genuinely curious about this space and ready to build fluency quickly on the job.

• Advanced Excel, including the ability to deconstruct sophisticated, undocumented legacy workbooks.

• Demonstrated ability to explore data and figure out why something happened - forming and testing your own hypotheses, not just reporting what happened.

• Fluent English, spoken and written. This is a fully remote role and you'll communicate directly, in English, with business stakeholders and executive leadership as well as data analysts and engineers across our global organization, where English is the shared working language.

Preferred Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related quantitative/technical field strongly preferred; equivalent experience acceptable. Master's degree is a plus.

• Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, Strategy, Operations, or another analytically intensive business function.

• Familiarity with financial concepts such as revenue, margin, profitability, forecasting, and variance analysis.

• Experience modernizing legacy Excel-based reporting or analytical processes.

• Experience working in an environment where data is distributed across multiple systems and isn't always perfectly documented.

• Experience working effectively in a fully remote, distributed team environment.

• Exposure to AI/agentic tooling, or experience helping design how AI gets applied to a business process (e.g., LLM workflows, tool/function calling, RAG, MCP, building AI-assisted reporting or automation).

• Machine learning, statistical modeling, or formal data science experience is welcome but not required.

Compensation

Additional Information

data.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

Key Responsibilities

Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development

  • Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.
  • Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.
  • Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.
  • Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.
  • Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.
  • Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving

  • Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.
  • Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.
  • Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.
  • Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

Quality & Documentation

  • Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.
  • Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.
  • Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications

  • D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.
  • Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.
  • Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
  • Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated scientific curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting development of NGS-based research or diagnostic assays.
  • Familiarity with cancer genomics, somatic variant analysis, and liquid biopsy applications.
  • Experience working with cell-free DNA (cfDNA) or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) datasets.
  • Knowledge of bioinformatics best practices, reproducible research methods, and software version control tools.
  • Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
  • Exposure to regulated product development environments, including CAP/CLIA, FDA, or IVD development processes.
  • Experience collaborating closely with both laboratory and computational scientists.

What Success Looks Like

  • Demonstrates strong scientific judgment and analytical rigor.
  • Develops a deep understanding of assay biology, experimental design, and data interpretation.
  • Contributes high-quality analyses that inform key development decisions.
  • Builds effective partnerships across wet-lab and computational teams.
  • Continuously learns new technologies, methods, and scientific domains.
  • Grows toward increasing technical ownership and leadership within assay development programs.

#LI-Hybrid, or #LI-Remote

For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the range is $152,000 - $170,000.

For candidates working remote (US), the range is $122,000 - $158,000.

data.description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

data.description:
En Product Hackers estamos construyendo el mejor equipo de Growth del mundo. Personas altamente creativas, inteligentes e ingeniosas pero con mente científica y absoluta obsesión por los productos digitales. Queremos ser el Space X del Growth, por eso buscamos a los mejores humanos, con las mejores capacidades para convertirlos en astronautas.

Si quieres sumergirte en el universo de los productos digitales, visitar los planetas de nuestros clientes (sus productos digitales) y terraformarlos para que puedan albergar vida (usuarios y clientes) este es el lugar ideal para pasar de ser un mísero humano a un astronauta del producto digital. Sí, también somos muy frikis del espacioX y esas cosas.

astronaut (2).gif

🚀 Además, en Product Hackers encontrarás un equipo que aprende y comparte constantemente, que busca que las ideas se experimenten, se prueben y se implementen sin miedo, porque aquí compartimos aprendizajes, crecemos juntos gracias a esta pasión por el Growth

Somos remote-first y contamos con grandes profesionales de diferentes puntos del mundo.

¿CUÁL ES TU MISIÓN?

Como Growth Analytics Engineer, tu misión será que el dato del que dependen las decisiones sea fiable: instrumentar bien desde el principio, auditar lo que ya existe y dejar la medición preparada para experimentar. Trabajarás sobre e-commerce y producto, y con equipos que necesitan leer resultados sin dudar de los números.

Aquí no vas a trabajar solo con herramientas de terceros: tenemos plataforma propia de experimentación y un entorno de agentes con MCPs que usamos a diario para auditar y analizar.

Y no te quedarás detrás del dato, serás quien lo explique al cliente, quien defienda qué merece medirse y quien haga visible el valor del trabajo ante sus equipos de negocio.

¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS CONTRIBUCIONES?

  • Etiquetado de eventos en GTM para GA4 y otras herramientas de analítica.

  • Configuraciones avanzadas en GA4 para clientes.

  • Diseño de exploraciones en GA4 y de los cuadros de mando que las acompañan.

  • Creación de informes de resultados en Data Studio y Power BI.

  • Ejecución de auditoría de instrumentación para cada nuevo cliente.

  • Diseño y liderazgo de los planes de medición y de las taxonomías de eventos entre plataformas (web, app, servidor)

  • Referente técnico de instrumentación de experimentos para los equipos internos y los stakeholders de los proyectos en los que participa.

  • Implantación y revisión del consentimiento en la medición (Consent Mode v2, CMPs) y explicación de su efecto sobre los datos.

  • Instrumentación y validación de experimentos: que la variante quede registrada, que el reparto de muestra sea correcto y que no haya huecos de datos entre la herramienta de test y GA4.

  • Conciliación de datos entre la plataforma del cliente (e-commerce, CRM o backend) y GA4: detectar discrepancias en sesiones, conversiones e ingresos, encontrar la causa y proponer el arreglo.

  • Interlocución directa con los equipos del cliente (marketing, producto, negocio): presentar resultados, explicar discrepancias sin tecnicismos y acordar prioridades.

  • Gestión de inicio a fin de la parte de medición de tus proyectos: alcance, plazos, seguimiento y comunicación de avances.

  • Traducir los datos en recomendaciones accionables para el cliente, no solo en informes.

¿QUÉ TE HARÁ TRIUNFAR CON NOSOTROS?

Hard skills

  • Tener experiencia de +3 años:

    • Instrumentando productos digitales (e-commerce, lead generation o áreas privadas): dataLayer, eventos de funnel y de conversión, y validación de la calidad del dato.

  • Tener experiencia de 2 años en:

    • Entornos ágiles.

    • Creación de dashboards para clientes.

    • Gestión eficaz de tareas y proyectos complejos.

    • Jira, Trello, Asana o similar.

    • Trato directo con cliente: reuniones de seguimiento, presentación de resultados y gestión de expectativas.

  • Contar con altas habilidades de análisis en GA4

  • Tener capacidad avanzada de instrumentar con Google Tag Manager.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role


We are looking for a Senior Analyst - Analytics and Insights, FP&A to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based out of our Mohali Office, reporting to the Senior Manager - Analytics and Insights, FP&A in the FP&A department. In this role, you will build decision-grade analytics and forecasting capabilities by combining strong financial domain understanding with modern data and AI techniques. You will work hands-on in Snowflake, DBT, SQL, and Python to develop scalable datasets, automate planning and analysis workflows, and prototype Finance AI agents that accelerate insight generation with strong controls around accuracy and governance.


What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Partner with FP&A stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical requirements, deliver clear insight narratives, and drive measurable process improvements across planning and performance management
  • Model and analyze complex datasets in Snowflake using advanced SQL and Python to power recurring analysis, management reporting, and forecasting workflows
  • Build and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines and transformation logic to ensure consistent data availability, freshness, and reconciliation across source systems and curated data layers
  • Develop and support diverse forecasting solutions—spanning driver- and rule-based models with scenario toggles and sensitivity analysis alongside machine learning approaches such as time series, regression, and classification with feature engineering and backtesting
  • Build and iterate Finance AI agents that automate repeatable workflows, including controlled variance explanation drafts, anomaly detection summaries, governed Q&A over finance definitions and model documentation, and automated data refresh validation and commentary

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You take full ownership of your work, pairing strategic vision with hands-on execution and unwavering integrity to deliver meaningful business outcomes.
  • You build high-trust partnerships across teams, elevating collective success and embracing candid, constructive feedback to drive clarity and alignment.
  • You are a pragmatic builder who thrives on creating, iterating, and shipping practical v1 solutions quickly while maintaining strong technical rigor.
  • You anchor decisions in rigorous data and empirical evidence rather than assumptions, uncovering the ground truth to guide smarter financial outcomes.
  • You design durable, scalable solutions and processes that connect daily analytical execution to long-term global growth.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

  • Expert proficiency in SQL (Snowflake) and strong working knowledge of Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and model prototyping
  • Hands-on experience with dbt (running and debugging models, extending transformations, adding tests, and maintaining documentation) alongside building or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines with rigorous data validation and reconciliation
  • Practical experience with forecasting methodologies, including rule- and driver-based modeling as well as exposure to ML-based forecasting and backtesting concepts

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

data.title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics
data.description:
Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About the role

This role turns people data into the decisions that shape how Wealthsimple hires, grows, and keeps its people. You will build the models, the analysis, and the data products that show how talent moves through Wealthsimple, where it concentrates, who is at risk of leaving, and what the workforce looks like a year out. Reporting to the Director, People Analytics, you will own that work end to end, from the question through to the thing people actually use. Success looks like recurring people decisions getting made from what you built.

About the team

People Analytics sits within People and Communications. We are growing the people domain and want to get deeper into our data, through the models, data products, and analysis that leaders across the company use to make calls about talent. We are a small team, building like a startup inside the People team. Analytics developers own the data foundation, analysts handle day-to-day reporting, and software engineers build the products that put insights in front of managers. As our first data scientist, you will help set what best in class looks like for people analytics at Wealthsimple.

What you’ll do

  • Own the model building and the deeper analysis on people data, including attrition risk, workforce forecasting, and how talent moves and develops across the company.

  • Build people data products that leaders keep coming back to, working with our software engineers to put them in front of managers across Wealthsimple.

  • Move up and down the data stack as the question demands, from raw data through to the model and the surface it lands on.

  • Turn open questions from leaders and partners across the company into analysis they can act on, and be clear about what the data can and cannot support.

  • Bring statistical rigour to how we understand talent density and performance management, forming hypotheses and testing them so people decisions are data informed.

  • Set the analytical standard for the function and raise the level of craft around you, through how we test, document, and review our work.

Skills you bring

  • 5+ years in data science or a related quantitative role, owning ambiguous problems end to end.

  • Advanced SQL and Python, applied to work you have taken all the way to production rather than left in a notebook.

  • Applied statistics and causal inference. You can pick a method, defend it, and explain why a correlation is not enough for the decision in front of you.

  • Experience building and evaluating predictive models on messy operational data, including the judgment to say when a model is not the right answer.

  • Experience turning analysis into recommendations that senior leaders act on, including pushing back when the question itself is wrong. You lead with the outcome, then explain how you got there.

  • Comfort working close to the data layer, with modelled datasets, point-in-time history, and a cloud data platform such as Snowflake.

Nice to have

  • HR data literacy: employee lifecycle events, job hierarchies, headcount types, and compensation structures.

  • Workforce planning or headcount forecasting.

  • Experience with survey and engagement data.

  • Experience measuring people performance, such as review ratings, calibration outcomes, or goal attainment.

People analytics experience helps, but it is not required. If you have done this kind of work in product, marketing, growth, or customer analytics and you are curious about people data, we want to hear from you.

Who you are

  • You are energised by building, and you do not need a paved road to do good work.

  • You think about privacy the way a good engineer thinks about security, as a design constraint rather than an obstacle.

  • You would rather ship a useful answer and improve it than hold a perfect one back.

  • You are direct about uncertainty and say what you do not know before anyone asks.

  • You move between technical and non-technical conversations naturally.

  • You are pragmatic about AI tools and know where they speed you up and where they do not.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Ground-floor impact: Most of this work hasn’t been done yet, so you’ll shape how it gets done.

  • Visibility: Your work goes in front of leadership and shapes real decisions about talent.

  • Builders around you: Your models ship into products managers use, not slide decks

Why Wealthsimple?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

The Analytics Engineer builds and maintains the data assets that power Ferrellgas reporting, self-service analytics, and AI initiatives. This role supports development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping turn raw source data into clean, business-ready data, builds and maintains Power BI semantic models, and automates the manual processes that slow the business down. The Analytics Engineer shares responsibility for the team’s data models and transformation code, providing coverage and continuity across the full data flow from raw data to business-ready data. The ideal candidate has strong data modeling fundamentals, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, and a builder’s mindset for replacing manual work with reliable, automated solutions.

At Ferrellgas our corporate roles are fully remote, enabling talented professionals to support our field operations from wherever they are. These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we’re committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and support the Snowflake data transformation layer, which together serve as the foundation for reporting, self-service analytics, and AI data agents.
  • Support development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping transform raw data into business-ready data that is structured, performant, and ready for downstream consumption.
  • Design and build transformation logic that applies business rules consistently and aligns with the team’s standards and architecture.
  • Publish and maintain well documented and performant Power BI semantic models that enable reporting and self-service.
  • Identify, prioritize, and automate recurring manual processes such as data refreshes, extracts, and report distribution.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models and validate that models answer real business questions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented SQL transformations using dbt, with Git-based version control.
  • Manage data projects end to end, coordinating with IT source system owners, the Data Warehouse team, and business end users from requirements gathering through development, testing, and delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and documentation practices established by the team.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues in the transformation and semantic layers.
  • Stay current with Snowflake and reporting platform capabilities and contribute ideas for improving the team’s analytics infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics, or related field).

  • Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, including Git-based version control.
  • Experience with AI platforms is a plus, particularly integrating AI tools such as LLMs, Snowflake Cortex, or AI agents with enterprise data.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and documentation.
  • Collaborative team player who can work effectively with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
  • Passionate about learning new technologies and adapting to changing environments.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, or otherwise authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

Hear from our current employees and discover the people behind Ferrellgas: Employee Testimonials

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between.
